items.name: Automation TDP
items.description: The Automation Technical Decision Point (TDP) positions Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform as the mission-critical foundation for modernizing IT, using a unified governance framework to consolidate fragmented tools and deliver measurable outcomes like 68% faster deployments and reduced downtime.

items.name: AIOps: Turn Intelligence into Action
items.description: This AIOps tactic positions Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform as the "action layer" that transforms monitoring insights into automated remediation, enabling IT teams to replace manual troubleshooting with event-driven workflows that optimize costs and ensure AI policy compliance.

items.name: Optimize and Modernize IT Ops
items.description: This tactic positions Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform as a unified foundation to eliminate tool silos and operational debt, allowing sellers to demonstrate how centralized governance secures immediate operational wins while accelerating strategic initiatives like VM modernization and cloud migration.

items.name: Automate at Scale
items.description: This tactic helps sellers migrate DIY users and scale existing customers by positioning Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform as a secure, enterprise-grade standard that breaks down operational silos and unlocks the ROI needed to shift resources toward strategic innovation.

items.name: Network automation
items.description: This tactic enables sellers to position Red Hat Network Automation as the solution for modern network complexity, replacing manual processes and downtime with a resilient, multi-vendor automation framework that ensures faster response times and seamless scalability.
